jobs.title: Tech Recruiter
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Anderco

jobs.description: En bref   Chez Picnic, notre croissance opérationnelle en France s’accélère : plusieurs nouvelles zones logistiques sont prévues dès fin 2026 et début 2027. En tant que Recruteur / Recruteuse Supply Chain & Opérations , tu joueras un rôle clé dans cette expansion en recrutant les leaders qui construiront et feront grandir nos nouveaux sites logistiques. Ton périmètre couvre des postes clés pour nos opérations : superviseurs, chefs d’équipe, ingénieurs projets et responsables de sites. Tu travailleras au plus près de nos équipes opérationnelles et de nos Hiring Managers, en comprenant leurs enjeux, en construisant les stratégies de recrutement adaptées et en identifiant les profils capables de faire grandir Picnic. Chez Picnic, le recrutement ne consiste pas simplement à remplir des postes. Nous voulons construire des équipes solides et durables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur les talents que nous recrutons. Tu auras donc une vraie autonomie sur tes recrutements : tu définiras tes priorités, piloteras tes pipelines et challengeras les approches lorsque cela sera nécessaire pour atteindre tes objectifs sans faire de compromis sur la qualité. Tu seras également un véritable partenaire du business : tes Hiring Managers sont directement impliqués dans le recrutement et considèrent la construction de leur équipe comme une priorité. Ton rôle sera de leur apporter ton expertise recrutement, de faciliter les prises de décision et de les conseiller tout au long du processus. Tes missions   Piloter tes recrutements de A à Z : tu prends en charge tes recrutements, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la signature, et construis les pipelines nécessaires pour atteindre tes objectifs. jobs.title: Director, Global People Analytics
jobs.description: Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We're hiring a Director of People Analytics to turn trusted people data into the business decisions Toast makes about its workforce, and to strengthen the business impact of Toast's People programs. Toast has built a strong analytics foundation over the past several years: a cloud data warehouse, self-service dashboards, an AI-enabled insights product, an employee listening program, and data science that has already shaped business decisions. The next stage is moving from standardized to strategic: making People Analytics the partner business leaders rely on for their most important talent decisions. You'll lead a team across data engineering, analytics, data science and employee listening, based in the US and India. You'll report to the leader of Talent Infrastructure and work closely with Business Leaders, People Leadership, Finance, IT and our AI and data partners. Our purpose: answer the people questions that cut across Toast's data, and make sure those answers change a decision. A day in the life (Responsibilities) Strategy and leadership: Set and communicate the vision, North Star and roadmap for People Analytics, with buy-in from People and business leaders. Own People data strategy and reporting strategy, including metric definitions, governance and data trust. Partner with Toast's AI and data teams so People data powers AI-enabled insights safely and responsibly. Business partnership and impact: Build lasting partnerships with leaders, across Toast's major business areas and the People team. Turn analysis into clear stories and recommendations that leaders act on, and build that skill across the team.
